purpose: Source provenance, permissions and delivery status; not evidence of end-to-end live browser QA.

sources.name: LA City Department of City Planning zoning
sources.coverage: Los Angeles City; visible study area
sources.attribution: City of Los Angeles, Department of City Planning
sources.policy: Hosted ArcGIS FeatureServer; observe endpoint terms and response headers
sources.cache: Up to six hours for ID lookups and polygon GeoJSON, capped by provider directives; browser session retains polygons by OBJECTID
sources.limits: Viewport-scoped ArcGIS returnIdsOnly discovery; missing geometries retrieved in 40-ID batches with three concurrent requests, published progressively; no fixed total request cutoff.

sources.name: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb 2024 census tracts
sources.coverage: Pilot: Los Angeles County; visible study area
sources.cache: up to 30 days unless response directives restrict
sources.limits: Provider query asks for up to 251 tracts; >250 or truncation triggers viewport-bounded subdivision up to depth 6; at most 3 concurrent geographic requests, no fixed total per-navigation request cutoff.

sources.name: Census Reporter 2020–2024 ACS five-year tabulations
sources.coverage: Pilot: visible Los Angeles County tract GEOIDs
sources.attribution: U.S. Census Bureau ACS estimates via Census Reporter
sources.cache: up to 90 days unless response directives restrict
sources.limits: Batches of up to 40 visible GEOIDs, two concurrent requests; ACS sampling error and suppressed estimates.

sources.name: Los Angeles County Assessor parcels and tax-roll assessments
sources.coverage: Pilot: parcel polygons inside visible Los Angeles County study rectangle
sources.date: Parcel-specific Roll_Year from source (not a uniform current-year price)
sources.attribution: Los Angeles County Office of the Assessor / LA County GIS
sources.policy: Public LA County ArcGIS parcel service metadata; provider permissions and cache headers govern use
sources.cache: HTTP/IndexedDB up to 24 hours, further restricted by source response directives; memory retains previously visited parcels
sources.limits: Region-bounded ArcGIS ID lookup; 35 missing parcel polygons per request, max 3 concurrent; 12,000 retained geometry features. Never a full county mirror.
sources.interpretation: Assessed land and improvement roll values are NOT recent sale prices, market prices or household wealth.
